Definition: from G2844; communicative, i.e. (pecuniarily) liberal:--willing to communicate.
BiblicalUsage: Koinonikos means willing to communicate, ready to share. 1 Timothy 6:18 tells the rich to do good, to be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rich man's duty is one word: willing, because God does not ask for a grudging gift but for a ready hand.
